title: Version/Luna III
text:
* Adjusted filtering options in [[Character/Menu|Character Menu]] to display relevant information more clearly.
* Increased the [[Reputation]] EXP obtained from [[Bounties]], [[Request]]s, [[Supply Notice]], and [[Archon Quest]]s by 100% and increased [[World Quest]]s from 20 to 100.
* Decreased the requirements for the [[achievement]]s [[QUEST CLEAR]] and [[Hero-in-Training]].
* Adjusted claiming [[Daily Commission]] rewards to give option to exchange [[Encounter Points]].
* Tracking in [[Adventurer Handbook]] > Enemies now shows multiple targets and shows more spawn locations for certain enemies.
* Combat Optimizations for [[Venti]] and [[Klee]]:
** Optimized enemy-tracking mechanic for Venti's [[Wind's Grand Ode|Elemental Burst]] so the Stormey will form based on enemy position and count.
** Optimized Klee's [[Kaboom!|Normal Attack]] animations to be faster and more fluid.
* Increased Artifact Definition with [[Sanctifying Elixir]] from 1 to 2 times each version.
* Optimized penalty system to send mail when recently reported account banned and banned accounts have a ban icon on their profile avatar.
* Adjusted [[Battle Pass]] missions for [[Imaginarium Theater]] to carry over to next version of cleared for the month.

;Enemies
* Optimizes the combat experience when challenging the enemy "[[Experimental Field Generator]]": Characters can now deal damage to it during the brief animation in which it deploys its Gravity Reduction Field.

;Characters
* When sorting characters by "[[Constellation]] Unlock Level" in the "[[Character/Menu|Character]]" list, each character's Constellation level will be displayed.
* When sorting characters by "[[Friendship]]" in the "Character" list, each character's Friendship level will be displayed instead of their character level.
* Adds a "Party Enhancement" filter to the "Character" list.

;Artifacts
* In the "[[Inventory]] > [[Artifact]]s" interface, an "Enhance" button in the lower-right corner will be displayed for Artifacts that haven't reached the maximum level. Click it to go directly to the enhancement interface. (Before this update, enhancing an Artifact required going through the "Details" button.) The "Details" button will still be displayed for Max-level Artifacts.
* In the "Artifacts > Enhance" interface, a higher-level Artifact will be displayed first for Artifacts of the same quality that can be used as materials. (Previously, lower-level Artifacts were shown first.)
* Increases the Definition Count per Artifa

title: Version/Luna III
text:
;Quests
* Fixes an issue whereby the objective "Try to seal the Wild Hunt" in the Archon Quest "[[In the Shadows of Night]]" could not be completed after defeating the [[Wild Hunt]] enemies under certain circumstances, preventing quest progression.
* Fixes an issue in [[Tighnari]]'s [[Story Quest]] "[[The Unanswerable Problems]]," during the "[[Into the Hinterland]]" quest, whereby opening the [[Paimon Menu]] outside the intended quest area would cause [[Paimon]] to disappear abnormally.
* Fixes an issue whereby [[The Damselette]]'s head animations would occasionally display abnormally during the [[World Quest]] "[[Homecoming's Faint Glow]]."
* Fixes an issue whereby the [[Commission]] Quest "[[Saurian Versus Mountain]]" would fail if Travelers reached the quest objective using a specific path.
* Fixes an issue whereby the music box cutscene was missing when using the [[Quest Item]] "[[Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box]]."

;Enemies
* Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "[[Radiant Moonfly]]" would abnormally sink into the ground when entering combat under certain circumstances.
* Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "[[Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect Landcruiser]]" would face an incorrect direction after sprinting under certain circumstances.
* Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "[[Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker]]" would abnormally reveal its true form and weaknesses when summoning Radiant Reflections under certain circumstances.
* Fixes an issue whereby, when enemies "[[Wilderness Hunter]]," "[[Wilderness Exile]]," and "Local Legend: [[Sigurd]]" were in the "Grief-Stricken" state within [[Albedo]]'s Solar Isotoma field, their DMG taken would not trigger the AoE Geo DMG from Solar Isotoma.
* Fixes an issue whereby the tutorial for the enemy "[[Black Serpent Knight: Rockbreaker Ax]]" would fail to trigger correctly under certain circumstances. After the update, Travelers who have previously challenged this enemy will have this tutorial automatically unlocked.
* Fixes an issue whereby enemies "[[Yumkasaur Whelp]]," "[[Tatankasaur Whelp]]," "[[Tatankasaurus]]," and "[[Frostnight Scion]]" would occasionally exhibit abnormal behavior when entering combat.
* Fixes an issue whereby certain Character [[Talent]] effects that do not deal damage would abnormally accumulate "damage received" progress when the enemy "Frostnight Herra" was in the "Gloomveiled" state.
* Fixes an issue whereby, if the enemy "[[Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel]]" was [[Frozen]] while emerging fro

# There is an issue whereby when equipping headwear for a Manekina with the "[[Candlelit Wizard: Pumpkin Candy (Manekina)|Candlelit Wizard: Pumpkin Candy]]" cosmetic, the bun hairstyle displays an abnormal hair color if "Hide Back of Hair" is selected in the component adjustment settings. This issue will be fixed in a future version. # Due to an issue with saving completion records for "[[Natlan]]" characters in the "[[Test Run]]" event, if Travelers already own the relevant character and have completed the corresponding challenge in a previous version, they will still be unable to directly claim the challenge rewards in the new "Test Run" event.
Starting from Version "Luna III," the system will record event progress based on first-time completion. When the "Test Run" challenge for the relevant "Natlan" character becomes available again, the system will determine whether Travelers are eligible to claim rewards directly based on challenge records after Version "Luna III" and current character ownership status.

title: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
text:
{{Talent Infobox |image = Talent Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko.png |character = Lauma |type = Elemental Skill |info = Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a {{Extra Effect|Frostgrove Sanctuary|Frostgrove Sanctuary|A magical array that protects the Moonchanters and can be summoned by using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko.
The Frostgrove Sanctuary will follow the active character, dealing a single instance of {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.}} with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

'''Tap'''
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}}.

'''Hold'''
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 {{Extra Effect|Verdant Dew|Verdant Dew|When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource.
Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.}}. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} and another instance of {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of {{Extra Effect|Moon Song|Moon Song|A melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song.}}. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

'''Lauma''' is a playable {{Dendro}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''. 

As the Moonchanter of the [[Frostmoon Scions]], Lauma is a well-respected and wise figure within the group, and trusted by all manners of wildlife. She is immeasurably kind and seeks to find a calm resolution to any conflict; though her steel will reveal itself should people mistake her benevolence for acquiescence.

title: Bloom
Bloom
text:
If a Dendro Core's duration expires while the character who created it is in the party and alive, it will explode, dealing {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} in a '''5m''' radius to both enemies and players. Otherwise, it will disappear without the explosion.

If {{Pyro}} is inflicted upon a Dendro Core, the '''Burgeon''' reaction will be triggered, which consumes the Dendro Core, and deals increased {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} in a '''5m''' radius to both enemies and players.

If {{Electro}} is inflicted upon a Dendro Core, the '''Hyperbloom''' reaction will be triggered, which transforms the Dendro Core into a Sprawling Shot that homes in on the closest enemy (or ally, if triggered by an enemy/the environment), dealing increased {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} in a '''1m''' radius on hit to both enemies and players.

DMG dealt to players by all Bloom-related reactions are '''2%''' of the DMG dealt to enemies, no matter which party triggers the reaction.

Burgeon and Hyperbloom can both be triggered by a party other than the one which triggered the original Bloom, including the environment, and their damage scale with the stats of the party responsible for applying Pyro or Electro.

title: Bloom
text:
Certain character abilities and event buffs will cause the Bloom reaction to produce Bountiful Cores instead of Dendro Cores. Bountiful Cores explode '''0.4''' seconds after their creation, dealing {{Color|AoE Dendro DMG}} in a '''6.5m''' radius to both enemies and players. DMG dealt to players is '''2%''' of the DMG dealt to enemies.

Burgeon and Hyperbloom cannot be triggered on Bountiful Cores. Bountiful Cores share the upper limit of 5 with regular Dendro Cores.

text:
* Increased the maximum number of [[Artifact]]s stored in the [[Inventory]] from 2,400 to 2,700.

;Quests
# Adds a teleportation function for [[quest]] objectives: Some quest objective locations now support teleportation. Select a supported objective on the "[[Map]]" screen and click the "Go" button to teleport to the quest objective or a nearby location. (This feature initially applies to certain quests in the Version 7.0 update. Future versions expand support to more new quests and further optimize the feature.)

;Enemies
# Optimizes how attempts are counted for the related "[[Valiant Chronicles]]" challenge objective to: "Before the [[Prism Slime]] first gathers light and swells, make sure it attempts to absorb energy no more than 2 times," so that the count more accurately reflects the enemy's skill actions.

;Exploration
# Adjusts how Multi-Layered Maps are displayed on the "[[Map]]" screen to prevent the layouts of unexplored areas from being revealed prematurely and affecting the gameplay experience: A Multi-Layered Map and its corresponding button now appear only after the Traveler has reached or unlocked the relevant area (before this adjustment, Multi-Layered Maps were always visible). If the corresponding area contains a tracked point, including a tracked Teleport Waypoint, the Multi-Layered Map and its button remain visible.
# Optimizes the display logic when the "[[Luna Treasure Compass]]" and "[[Segment-Domain Treasure Compass]]" mark clues: Increases the display priority of [[Oculus]] icons to prevent them from being obscured by other icons. (The "[[Cryo Treasure Compass]]" introduced in Version 7.0 also incorporates this optimization.)
# Increases the pin limit on the Map from 300 to 350.

;Adventurer Handbook
# Optimizes the sorting logic on the "[[Domain]]s" page of the [[Adventurer Handbook]]: All Domains are now consistently sorted based on the version in which they were added and their unlock status, with unlocked Domains from more recent versions appearing higher in the list.

;Inventory
# Increases the combined [[Inventory]] capacity for [[Character Development Item]]s, [[Food]], [[Material]]s, [[Gadget]]s, [[Quest Item]]s, and [[Precious Item]]s from 2,300 to 2,600.
# Increases the maximum number of [[Artifact]]s that can be stored in the Inventory from 2,400 to 2,700.

;Audio
# Optimizes the sound effects in certain scenes, interfaces, and quests.
# Optimizes Chinese and Japanese voice-over lines in certain quests.
